title: Written is not committed: the transaction boundary
goal: Distinguish an in-transaction write, rollback and commit using own synthetic catalog items.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P4. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A card has passed Записать, and then the operation fails. Should the card remain? The answer depends on the transaction boundary. First deliberately roll a change back, then perform a separate successful commit.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: One business fact needs one decision
paragraphs: If a request and dependent record must appear together, do not accept them independently. A transaction groups changes into commit or rollback. It does not make the algorithm correct or replace validation. Identify all affected data and require either complete consistency or the previous state.

A transaction groups database changes until commit or rollback. The function generates a unique synthetic name, starts a transaction, writes a card and deliberately raises an exception. Its handler calls ОтменитьТранзакцию. A fresh lookup outside the rolled-back transaction must return an empty reference. A successful write before rollback does not establish final persistence.

sections.title: Prepare the experiment while retaining P4
paragraphs: Continue your own P4 copy after preserving its DT and sources. Do not load a full configuration over prior work. If using the supplied training template, load service-desk-documents-v2 into a new separate infobase and distinguish it from your continuing work.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The first unique customer is written inside a transaction, then a deliberate failure triggers rollback. A fresh exact-name lookup finds nothing. The second path writes another name and commits; lookup returns that reference. These are two distinct outcomes, not deletion of earlier customers.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Boundary and lifetime
paragraphs: Keep explicit transactions short and finish every path. Do not wait for users, network or long reports while holding a transaction. Some platform operations already have a transactional context; understand the call site before nesting another boundary. A nested start is not an independent backup.

A second transaction creates a separately named accepted card and commits it. A fresh lookup compares the resulting reference. Both checks matter: absence of the rejected name does not prove another commit, and an accepted card does not prove the first rollback. No existing catalog items are cleared or modified.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: Two new records were written in one transaction, and failure occurred before commit. What should fresh lookups show after rollback?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: Both writes roll back when both belong to that transaction. A successful Записать inside its boundary is not final commit. This does not extend to arbitrary external HTTP requests or files.

sections.title: Preserve the original failure
paragraphs: On exception, roll back the transaction you started and propagate the failure with safe diagnostics. Do not continue as if successful. Rollback cannot undo actions outside the transaction, especially files and external requests. Those need another coordination and idempotency protocol.

A database transaction does not undo arbitrary external effects. A sent message, external file write or third-party HTTP request is not promised to disappear after rollback. This experiment uses no real network or other people’s data. Integration needs delivery protocols, journals, idempotency and agreed compensation, introduced later.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: Each separate transaction has one outcome: rollback after failure, or commit after successful actions. The main function takes the first path, then begins a new transaction for the other.

flowchart.caption: Failure and success end differently
paths: Failure branch: ОтменитьТранзакцию; an exact lookup after completion finds no rejected name.
Success branch: ЗафиксироватьТранзакцию; a separate read finds the accepted record.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Committing in the exception branch instead of rolling back lets execution continue while leaving the rejected customer behind. The independent expectation “name absent” detects the error even without an unhandled exception.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Choose a failure point
paragraphs: In a separate copy, inject failure between two related writes. Reopen a session and compare both tables after rejection. Then run the valid operation and expect exactly one effect. A before-state snapshot is essential because test setup itself may have changed the baseline.

The incorrect variant replaces rollback in the first error handler with commit. It compiles but retains the rejected item, so the absence assertion becomes false. Do not delete it to conceal the outcome; keep that experiment in its separate copy. A single file-base test does not establish concurrent server transactions or nested-transaction correctness.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
Explain which writes belong to the boundary and why database rollback does not undo external email or HTTP actions.
